```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sjPlot)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
```


## Helper functions
```{r define model functions, include=FALSE}
my_tab_model <- function(model){
  tab_model(model,
          df.method = "satterthwaite",
          show.stat = TRUE,
          CSS = list(css.tdata = 'padding:0.1cm;padding-left:0.2cm;padding-right:0.2cm;'),
          transform = NULL,
          string.stat = "z",
          string.p = "p > |t|",
          show.re.var = FALSE,
          show.icc = FALSE,
          show.r2 = FALSE,
          wrap.labels = 100,
          show.ngroups = FALSE,
          show.obs = FALSE)
}

scale_this <- function(x){
  (x - mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)
}

# tidy printer for a paired contrast on network-level means
paired_report <- function(a, b, label){
  d  <- a - b
  tt <- t.test(a, b, paired = TRUE)
  sprintf("%-46s %+.4f [%+.4f, %+.4f], t(%d) = %.2f, p = %.3g, d_z = %.2f",
          label, mean(d), tt$conf.int[1], tt$conf.int[2],
          tt$parameter, tt$statistic, tt$p.value, mean(d) / sd(d))
}
```

### Loading data
```{r read data, echo=T, warning=FALSE}
net_test <- read_csv("../data/net_exp1_test.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(curriculum = relevel(factor(curriculum), ref = "No Curriculum"),
         stimType   = factor(stimType, levels = c("Rule", "Exception")),
         seed       = factor(seed))

net_learn <- read_csv("../data/net_exp1_learning.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(curriculum = relevel(factor(curriculum), ref = "No Curriculum"),
         stimType   = factor(stimType, levels = c("Rule", "Exception")),
         seed       = factor(seed))

n_distinct(net_test$seed)   # networks
```

### Test model (Fig. 2B)
```{r test mod}
test_mod <- lmer(p_correct ~ curriculum * stimType + (1 | seed),
                 data = net_test,
                 contrasts = list(stimType = "contr.sum"))
my_tab_model(test_mod)
```

```{r test contrasts}
# curriculum effects, separately for rule and exception stimuli
emm <- emmeans(test_mod, ~ curriculum | stimType)
contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "No Curriculum", infer = TRUE)

# the persistent simplicity bias: rule vs exception within each curriculum
pairs(emmeans(test_mod, ~ stimType | curriculum))
```

```{r test contrasts paired}
cellm <- net_test %>%
  group_by(seed, curriculum, stimType) %>%
  summarise(p = mean(p_correct), .groups = "drop")

get <- function(cur, st) cellm %>%
  filter(curriculum == cur, stimType == st) %>% arrange(seed) %>% pull(p)

cat(paired_report(get("Simple to Complex","Exception"), get("No Curriculum","Exception"),
                  "Exception: simple-to-complex - no curriculum"), "\n")
cat(paired_report(get("Simple to Complex","Rule"),      get("No Curriculum","Rule"),
                  "Rule: simple-to-complex - no curriculum"), "\n")
cat(paired_report(get("Complex to Simple","Exception"), get("No Curriculum","Exception"),
                  "Exception: complex-to-simple - no curriculum"), "\n")
cat(paired_report(get("Complex to Simple","Rule"),      get("No Curriculum","Rule"),
                  "Rule: complex-to-simple - no curriculum"), "\n")
cat(paired_report(get("No Curriculum","Rule"),          get("No Curriculum","Exception"),
                  "No curriculum: rule - exception (at 30k steps)"), "\n")
```

### Learning phase, no-curriculum condition (Fig. 2A)

```{r learning order}
curve <- net_learn %>%
  filter(curriculum == "No Curriculum") %>%
  group_by(seed, stimType, step) %>%
  summarise(p = mean(p_correct), .groups = "drop")

CRIT <- 0.60          # robustness: repeat with 0.70 and 0.75
reach <- curve %>%
  filter(p >= CRIT) %>%
  group_by(seed, stimType) %>%
  summarise(step_crit = min(step), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stimType, values_from = step_crit) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rule), !is.na(Exception))

nrow(reach)                                   # networks reaching criterion on both
summary(reach$Rule); summary(reach$Exception)
t.test(reach$Exception, reach$Rule, paired = TRUE)
# wilcox.test(reach$Exception, reach$Rule, paired = TRUE)
```

```{r learning dip}
dip <- curve %>%
  filter(stimType == "Exception") %>%
  group_by(seed) %>%
  slice_min(p, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

t.test(dip$p, mu = 0.5)                       # exception accuracy vs chance
mean(dip$p < 0.5)                             # proportion of networks dipping
median(dip$step)                              # when the minimum occurs
```
